All of these details are in the "Model specifications" paragraph on page 5:

- **Layers:** 12-layer decoder-only Transformer with masked self-attention heads (p. 5). Figure 1 on page 4 also shows the block repeated "12x".
- **State size:** 768-dimensional states. The position-wise feed-forward networks use 3072-dimensional inner states (p. 5).
- **Attention heads:** 12 (p. 5).
- **Context length:** Training used minibatches of 64 randomly sampled, contiguous sequences of 512 tokens (p. 5).
- **Optimizer:** Adam (p. 5).
- **Peak learning rate:** 2.5e-4. It rose linearly from zero over the first 2000 updates and was then annealed to 0 on a cosine schedule (p. 5).

For fine-tuning, most tasks used a learning rate of 6.25e-5 with a batch size of 32 (p. 5).
